name: Sacheu Beauty
description: TikTok-native makeup brand built on its patent-pending STAY-N peel-off technology (Lip Liner STAY-N, Cheek STAY-N, liquid eyeshadow, LockStep Setting Spray and the DoubleDown Lip Definer), sold through its own site plus Ulta and Target, with billions of TikTok views and a #1-selling lip liner on Amazon.

evidence.summary: Brands Meet Creators' Sacheu Beauty campaign page recruits TikTok Shop creators for the LockStep Setting Spray and DoubleDown Lip Definer launch: $300 flat fee for 10 approved videos (creators with $25k+ GMV in 28 days), a $1,500 prize pool for the top 5 by GMV, and 20% commission on every sale; the leaderboard/prize track is open to all creators using the campaign link.
Sacheu's official store sells the STAY-N peel-off makeup line (lip liner, cheek, eyeshadow, contour, bundles) and shows retail availability at Ulta, Target, Amazon and TikTok Shop.

opportunity.title: Sacheu Beauty TikTok Shop creator campaign via Brands Meet Creators

reasons.niche_fit: Makeup built for TikTok demonstration (peel-off lip stain, setting spray) with 4 billion TikTok views claimed by its campaign page — near-perfect beauty-creator fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An active, structured TikTok Shop creator campaign with flat fees, prizes and commission, run through Brands Meet Creators.
reasons.compensation: 20% commission on every sale for the campaign products plus a $300 flat fee for qualifying creators and a $1,500 prize pool — published campaign terms.
reasons.contact_access: A public campaign page is the application route; no direct brand partnerships email was published on the pages fetched.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Campaign is open now; the flat-fee/sample tier requires $25k+ GMV in 28 days, but the commission and prize track is open to all creators.
reasons.credibility: National retail distribution at Ulta and Target and a #1-selling lip liner on Amazon, per the campaign page and its own store.

name: L'ange Hair
description: Premium hair styling tools and hair care brand (curling wands, flat irons, shampoos, conditioners and treatments) selling salon-quality at-home styling through langehair.com, with affiliate programs listed on ShareASale and Awin.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists L'ange Hair's program on ShareASale at 5% commission per sale with a 30-day cookie, website langehair.com.

L'ange's own Awin merchant profile describes its affiliate program: a 30-day referral period, elevated commission options for content and review placements, and application by submitting site URLs and promotional methods for review.

reasons.niche_fit: Hair tools and hair care are a core beauty-creator category with strong tutorial content fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Long-running network affiliate programs with elevated rates for content/review placements per its Awin profile, but no large public ambassador community was evidenced.
reasons.compensation: Published rate is 5% per sale (ShareASale listing, 30-day cookie) — modest but documented.
reasons.contact_access: Applications run through public network listings (ShareASale and Awin merchant profile).
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is open to applicants whose sites/channels pass merchant review.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC hair brand with a fast-growing affiliate network, per its own Awin profile.

name: Canvas Beauty
description: Fragrance-forward body care brand founded by Stormi Steele (Body Glaze, Body Drops and scented body oils) that became a TikTok Shop phenomenon — its founder set platform records for single-livestream sales; its TikTok Shop seller of record is based in Madison, Alabama, and the shop reports 3.0M units sold.

evidence.summary: Canvas Beauty Brand's TikTok Shop product pages (sold by CANVAS BEAUTY BRAND, 3.0M sold, 104.4K+ followers) carry creator videos marked 'Creator earns commission' from multiple creators, confirming products are open to TikTok Shop affiliate creators.

TikTok's newsroom reports Canvas Beauty founder/CEO Stormi Steele surpassed $2 million in sales during a single Black Friday LIVE — a platform record — and describes TikTok Shop's Creator Affiliate program as the route creators use to earn commissions on such products.

A Canvas affiliate contract hosted on shopcanvas.co (governing law Alabama, matching the brand's Alabama base) sets affiliate compensation at 10% of sales made through the affiliate's link or discount code, paid monthly via PayPal over a $100 threshold — an own-program route alongside TikTok Shop.

opportunity.title: Canvas Beauty TikTok Shop affiliate (creator commission on products)

reasons.niche_fit: Scent-layering and body-care routines are a proven TikTok beauty format and the brand was built by a creator-founder.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Creator-commission videos across its TikTok Shop listings and record-breaking creator-led LIVE selling reported by TikTok itself.
reasons.compensation: TikTok Shop per-product rates are not published in the sources fetched (recorded null); a Canvas affiliate contract on shopcanvas.co states 10% for its own-program route.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email or application page was found on the pages fetched; access is via TikTok Shop.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Products are open to TikTok Shop affiliate creators, as shown by multiple commission-earning creator videos on its listings.
reasons.credibility: Multimillion-dollar brand with 3.0M TikTok Shop units sold and national press coverage of its founder.

name: GoPure
description: US skincare brand launched in 2015 selling results-oriented, dermatologist-backed firming products — led by the viral Tighten & Lift Neck Cream — through its own site and a large TikTok Shop operation (official shop reports ~2.0M units sold).

evidence.summary: goPure's TikTok Shop listings (sold by Gopure official shop, ~2.0M sold) carry many creator videos marked 'Creator earns commission', confirming open affiliate selling on TikTok Shop.

FastMoss's goPure TikTok Shop data lists its hero products (Instant Lift Eye Gel, Tighten & Smooth Belly Cream, Neck Cream, Sculpt & Tone Arm Cream) at a 20% commission rate, with an active-product commission range of 0–20%, and reports roughly 13.4K affiliates for the shop — an absolute count in the tens of thousands.
goPure's official store sells its firming skincare line and claims 100,000+ five-star reviews and dermatologist recommendation.

reasons.niche_fit: Firming/neck-care skincare for the 40+ beauty audience is a high-performing TikTok Shop niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Extensive creator-commission video volume across its TikTok Shop catalog and a shop-level affiliate base reported at ~13.4K by FastMoss.
reasons.compensation: FastMoss lists goPure's hero TikTok Shop products at 20% commission (per-product rates vary, range 0–20%).
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email found on the pages fetched; entry is through TikTok Shop affiliate access.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to creators with TikTok Shop affiliate access; smaller creators publicly describe goPure as an early, accessible affiliate partner.
reasons.credibility: Established since 2015 with ~2.0M TikTok Shop units sold and 100,000+ five-star reviews claimed on its own site.

name: Based Bodyworks
description: Men's grooming brand (BASED) founded in 2022 by barber-creator Lance Baker, selling clean, plant-based hair, skin and body products (Texture Powder, Hair Clay, Sea Salt Spray) DTC and through TikTok Shop, where its official shop reports 4.1M units sold.

evidence.summary: BASED's TikTok Shop listings (BASED official shop, 4.1M sold, 4.5M followers) carry numerous creator videos marked 'Creator earns commission', confirming products are open to TikTok Shop affiliate creators.

Systemaic's brand teardown states Based has no standalone affiliate/ambassador page on its own site and that its affiliate lever runs through TikTok Shop's creator-commission system, estimating ~$5M in TikTok Shop sales in February 2026 (4th top-grossing beauty brand that month).

A marketer who ran Based Bodyworks' influencer program reports growing its TikTok Shop affiliate program from about 25 to 300+ creators — a few hundred creators, so saturation is recorded unknown rather than low.

opportunity.title: BASED (Based Bodyworks) TikTok Shop affiliate program

reasons.niche_fit: Men's grooming/looksmaxxing is a fast-growing creator niche and the brand is creator-founded.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A deliberately built TikTok Shop affiliate program (grown from ~25 to 300+ creators) plus heavy commission-earning creator video volume on its listings.
reasons.compensation: TikTok Shop creator commissions are confirmed by its listings, but no per-product rate is published in the sources fetched, so the rate is recorded null.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email or own-site program page was found; access runs through TikTok Shop.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Products are open to TikTok Shop affiliate creators, evidenced across multiple listings.
reasons.credibility: Official TikTok Shop reports 4.1M units sold; the brand's own site claims 3,000,000+ customers and 200,000+ five-star reviews.

name: Bask and Lather
description: Haircare brand (Bask and Lather Co.) known for scalp-care and hair-growth products — scalp treatments, shampoos, conditioners and leave-ins — sold through its own site and TikTok Shop, with an official affiliate program run on UpPromote.

evidence.summary: The Bask and Lather Co. Official Affiliate Program registration page (on UpPromote, linked to baskandlatherco.com) is open for applications and describes a tiered commission rate, cookie time and commission payouts; the tier amounts are not published on the public page, so the rate is recorded null.

A creator's screen recording of Bask and Lather Co's TikTok Shop collaboration interface shows an auto-approved sample offer and notes the brand's 19.3K collabs — an absolute creator-collaboration count in the tens of thousands.

opportunity.title: Bask and Lather Co. official affiliate program (UpPromote)

reasons.niche_fit: Scalp-care and hair-growth content is a strong, demonstration-friendly hair niche on TikTok.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An official open affiliate program plus very high TikTok Shop collaboration volume (19.3K collabs reported from the brand's collab interface).
reasons.compensation: The program advertises a tiered commission rate, but the tier amounts are not published on the public registration page, so the rate is recorded null.
reasons.contact_access: A public affiliate registration page collects creator social handles directly — a clear application route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Registration is open now via UpPromote, and TikTok Shop sample offers are auto-approved per creator reports.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC haircare brand with a 4.6-star TikTok Shop rating reported from its collab interface.

name: Wavytalk
description: Hair styling tools brand (hair dryers, straightener brushes, curling irons and multi-stylers) whose Awin profile describes it as a top-5 hair tools brand on Amazon and the #1 hair tools brand on TikTok Shop.

evidence.summary: Wavytalk's Awin merchant profile states the program terms: a standard 15% commission, opportunities for special commissions up to 25%, and a 30-day tracking window.

Wavytalk's Awin program terms and conditions (last updated Aug 8, 2025) confirm participation via the wavytalk.com affiliate referral program and repeat the 15%–25% commission range with a 30-day tracking cookie.

reasons.niche_fit: Affordable salon-style hair tools are a staple of beauty tutorial and review content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal network affiliate program plus tracked paid creator partnerships; the brand also gifts product to creators per creator-program listings.
reasons.compensation: Standard 15% commission published on its Awin profile, with special commissions up to 25% and a 30-day tracking window.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the public Awin merchant profile.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live on Awin and open to affiliate applicants.
reasons.credibility: Its Awin profile cites top-5 Amazon and #1 TikTok Shop positions in hair tools.

name: Beachwaver Co.
description: Hair tools company behind the Beachwaver rotating curling iron and a wider styling range, selling through beachwaver.com and running affiliate/ambassador programs for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Amazon creators, plus a salon-pro program.

evidence.summary: Beachwaver's own Affiliate & Creators page invites creators to join on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or Amazon, earn commission on sales from affiliate links, and receive product samples and exclusive access.

Beachwaver's ambassador page states ambassadors sell and earn 'up to 20% commission' with a unique promo code and custom URL — an 'up to' ceiling rather than a set rate, and a third-party directory lists 5.6% for its network program, so the rate is recorded null with the conflict documented.

reasons.niche_fit: Iconic rotating curling iron with highly demonstrable results — strong hair-tutorial fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Structured ambassador and creator programs on the brand's own site, with featuring on brand social channels as a stated perk.
reasons.compensation: The brand publishes only an 'up to 20%' ceiling and a directory lists 5.6% for a network variant — conflicting/ceiling figures, so the rate is recorded null.
reasons.contact_access: Public application pages for creators and ambassadors on the official site.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are public, though the creators page notes application windows (e.g., opening in September), so availability is partly seasonal.
reasons.credibility: Long-established, widely retailed hair tools brand with national press features.

name: Made by Mitchell
description: UK makeup brand founded in 2020 by makeup artist Mitchell Halliday (Mmmmitchell), known for Blursh liquid blush, Curve Case palettes and bold artistry products; it joined TikTok Shop in 2022/2023, became a cornerstone of UK TikTok beauty, and now sells into the US.

evidence.summary: Rateful's TikTok Shop data page confirms Made by Mitchell runs a TikTok Shop affiliate program: about 85% of its estimated $548K in TikTok Shop sales in the 30 days to Nov 6, 2026 came through affiliate creators' videos and LIVEs, across 22,226 items at a $24.68 average price; creators with TikTok Shop affiliate access add products to their showcase and earn commission on every sale. No commission rate is published.

The brand's own story page traces Made By Mitchell from Mitchell Halliday's 2020 founding through the 2021 Blursh launch and its move onto TikTok Shop, where it helped build the UK TikTok beauty community.

opportunity.title: Made by Mitchell TikTok Shop affiliate program

reasons.niche_fit: Artistry-led colour makeup from a creator-founder is a natural fit for beauty creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: About 85% of its TikTok Shop sales are estimated to come through affiliate creators — one of the most affiliate-driven beauty brands on the platform.
reasons.compensation: Commission on every TikTok Shop sale is confirmed, but no rate is published in the sources fetched, so the rate is recorded null.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email or application page was found on the pages fetched; access is via TikTok Shop.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to creators with TikTok Shop affiliate access via the showcase model, with free samples requestable in the affiliate center.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2020, a cornerstone UK TikTok Shop beauty brand with US expansion and national press coverage.

name: YIANNA
description: Shapewear brand selling Fajas Colombianas tummy-control bodysuits and brief shapers through TikTok Shop (YIANNA INC official shop, ~1.5M units sold, seller address in California) at $38.99–$68.99 price points; no own DTC storefront was verified — yianna.com belongs to an unrelated wedding-accessories business.

evidence.summary: FastMoss's Q1 2026 TikTok Shop top-10 ranks YIANNA's Fajas Colombianas shapewear #8 with $4.71M Q1 revenue, 114,740 orders and a published 15% commission rate at $38.99–$68.99.
YIANNA INC's official TikTok Shop product pages show 118.1K sold on the hero faja, a 1.5M-sold shop, and creator videos marked 'Creator earns commission', confirming open affiliate selling.

reasons.niche_fit: Shapewear try-on/transformation content is a reliably strong TikTok fashion format, though narrower than core beauty.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Creator-commission videos across its TikTok Shop listings and an estimated 91% of recent sales via affiliates reported by Rateful's brand data.
reasons.compensation: FastMoss publishes a 15% commission on its hero fajas line.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email, application page or own DTC site was verified; access is only via TikTok Shop.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to creators with TikTok Shop affiliate access.
reasons.credibility: Very large TikTok Shop sales (1.5M units), but seller entities vary across listings (YIANNA INC in California vs a Hong Kong company) and there is no verified brand website.
